steps.action: Navigate to the Reports module of boxName
steps.data: boxName: TC-4272 Box Module - Reports - Editing Velocity report with trend line presenting average value of velocity
steps.result:
Reports module loaded correctly. 

Velocity report with folLowing data is displaying:

Report name: Velocity for TC-4272 Alpha

Under the title there is a legend with labels displayed: Planned, Done, Velocity

There are 6 iterations in total in the report.

* Iteration 1: Planned (0.05) Done (1) Velocity (1)
* Iteration 2: Planned (0.5) Done (5) Velocity (3)
* Iteration 3: Planned (1) Done (1) Velocity (2.33)
* Iteration 4: Planned (10) Done (5) Velocity (3.67)
* Iteration 5: Planned (50) Done (15) Velocity (7)
* Iteration 6: Planned (100) Done (90) Velocity (36.67)

There is a scrollbar at the bottom of the chart.

Selected button is marked and the edit mode is displayed: The add report button is displayed next to the Edit button. Dashed borders are displayed around the chart. Chart types buttons are replaced with three buttons:

* Edit report size
* Edit report configuration
* Remove report

The buttons names are displayed in tooltips on hover.

steps.action: Click on the Edit report configuration button on reportName.
steps.result:
Modal with Velocity report configuration is loaded.

There is a Name field fulfilled with a text: Velocity for TC-4272 Alpha

Underneath, there is field Team. TC-4272 Alpha is selected.

BeLow, there are marked checkboxes: 

* Show iterations with empty capacity
* Show the velocity line on the chart

Under them there is field The number of iterations used to calculate velocity. The number is set to 3.

At the bottom, there are two buttons: Cancel and Save

steps.action: Change the number of iterations used to calculate velocity to iterationsNumber and click on Save button.
steps.result:
